posts.name: Chaosmancer
posts.cooked:
I agree that Expat having supreme power would defeat her image as the powerless daughter of a superpowered villian with a god complex.

 

However, as Wager Master's card I think shows, Expat does somewhat long for powers. She was raised by Dawn in the Citizens of the Sun compound, she was raised to believe she had powers and her mother cast her out when she didn't devlop them. We don't know the exact timeline, but Expat couldn't have escaped from Primalus if she was too young, and she's not that old when we see her. It had to have scarred her deeply and developing powers would be the ultimate slap in the face to her mother, especially if by then Expat had come to accept herself without powers and proceeded to deny them. A castout daughter, beleived to have been powerless, develops powers and then denies them in favor of being a "normal", Dawn would lose it

 

Thinking about Expat's story and how it would have been framed in the comics I would bet "Emigrant's song" would start with Expat on Insula Primalus, show her in conflict with her mother, then show her escaping and making her way to Rook City. Especially with how red her scar is in all the pictures I could find, it is very fresh. I like to think that RPG launcher happens before Expat leaves and she's hunting the T-rex.
